blockers.evidence: Both return witnesses must reconstruct xizi_dllseg (and in the first disjunct xizi_dll) over nodes_before ++ linklist_node_pre :: nodes_after. In the recomposition induction base case nodes_before = nil, the nonempty XiziDLL.dllseg constructor requires linklist_node_pre <> NULL. Neither return witness premise contains that fact. The available xizi_dll_links linklist_node_pre node_next node_prev is definitionally only two field stores and therefore does not entail non-nullness of the base node address.
concrete_attempts: A source_goal_version-bound fixed coq_tooling.py debug run established the middle split entailment shape by induction, including a spatial field-ownership distinctness argument for prefix nodes.
A matching recomposition induction was attempted using only current xizi_dllseg and xizi_dll_links resources. Its base case reduced to two residual pure goals: middle <> stop and middle <> NULL.

The middle <> stop obligation can be recovered in the full-resource branch from disjoint sentinel and middle link ownership, but middle <> NULL cannot be derived from xizi_dll_links because XiziDLL.links has no such pure conjunct.

The return_wit_1 value equation follows from node_next = linklist_pre and the xizi_dllseg stop boundary; the return_wit_2 value equation follows from nodes_after = node_next :: l0. The semantic blocker is spatial recomposition, not the value equations.
